question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
sql:
-- Check if there are other bowlers with 33 runs - and see the full ranking
WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as ball_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
extra_by_ball AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no, SUM(extra_runs) as total_extra
    FROM extra_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no
),
runs_with_extras AS (
    SELECT br.*, COALESCE(ebe.total_extra, 0) as extras
    FROM ball_runs br
    LEFT JOIN extra_by_ball ebe ON br.match_id = ebe.match_id AND br.over_id = ebe.over_id AND br.ball_id = ebe.ball_id AND br.innings_no = ebe.innings_no
),
over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, over_id, innings_no, bowler,
        SUM(ball_runs + extras) as total_over_runs
    FROM runs_with_extras
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no, bowler
),
max_over_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_over_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.innings_no, o.bowler, o.total_over_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN max_over_runs m ON o.match_id = m.match_id AND o.total_over_runs = m.max_runs
),
bowler_max_with_match AS (
    SELECT m.bowler, m.total_over_runs, m.match_id, m.over_id, m.innings_no,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.bowler ORDER BY m.total_over_runs DESC, m.match_id) as rn
    FROM max_overs m
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id as bowler_id,
    p.player_name,
    bm.match_id,
    CAST(bm.total_over_runs AS INTEGER) as runs_conceded
FROM bowler_max_with_match bm
JOIN player p ON bm.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bm.rn = 1
ORDER BY bm.total_over_runs DESC, p.player_id ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as ball_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
extra_by_ball AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no, SUM(extra_runs) as total_extra
    FROM extra_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no
),
runs_with_extras AS (
    SELECT br.*, COALESCE(ebe.total_extra, 0) as extras
    FROM ball_runs br
    LEFT JOIN extra_by_ball ebe ON br.match_id = ebe.match_id AND br.over_id = ebe.over_id AND br.ball_id = ebe.ball_id AND br.innings_no = ebe.innings_no
),
over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, over_id, innings_no, bowler,
        SUM(ball_runs + extras) as total_over_runs
    FROM runs_with_extras
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no, bowler
),
max_over_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_over_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.innings_no, o.bowler, o.total_over_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN max_over_runs m ON o.match_id = m.match_id AND o.total_over_runs = m.max_runs
),
bowler_max_with_match AS (
    SELECT m.bowler, m.total_over_runs, m.match_id, m.over_id, m.innings_no,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.bowler ORDER BY m.total_over_runs DESC, m.match_id) as rn
    FROM max_overs m
)
SELECT 
    p.player_id as bowler_id,
    p.player_name,
    bm.match_id,
    CAST(bm.total_over_runs AS INTEGER) as runs_conceded
FROM bowler_max_with_match bm
JOIN player p ON bm.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bm.rn = 1
ORDER BY bm.total_over_runs DESC, p.player_id ASC
LIMIT 10
